task_description: Total UI/UX redesign of HIJISTREAM web and mobile apps to feel strongly Netflix-inspired. Establishes a reusable design system with shared tokens, rebuilds all web components using shadcn/ui patterns + Tailwind CSS with Netflix dark cinematic palette, and redesigns the mobile Expo app to match. Preserves all existing TMDB content integration, watch progress tracking, and navigation logic.

verification.summary: All 4 web verification commands pass: lint (0 errors/warnings), typecheck (0 errors), build (successful vite build 2.27s), tests (22/22 pass). Mobile lint passes (0 errors).
